commit: fix: add parens to ClassExpression with decorators

truth.description: genericPrint in src/language-js/printer-estree.js returns the printed doc unwrapped only when printDecorators returned null, but printDecorators returns undefined for a node without decorators, so every node comes back wrapped in an array, printMemberExpression in member.js no longer sees the member-chain label on its object, and const resultValue = someObject.firstMethod().secondMethod().thirdMethod().someProperty; is printed with the chain on one line and .someProperty alone on the next line instead of the broken chain.

distractions.why: The typescript parser rejects a decorator on a class expression with an Expression expected error, so 4.ts is an expected error for that parser while the babel-ts run still formats it with the new parentheses.
